description: Wei Yan, fierce chinese general in the supplied pixel art style. Grey helmet with a long black horsehair crest, an orange scarf, olive and brown armor with gold trim, dark boots. He holds a great curved saber in the right hand
face: Hard glaring eyes and a dark moustache.
rear_detail: Seen from behind: the grey helmet with the long black crest, the orange scarf, olive armor, the curved saber at his right side.
guard_action: the right hand lifts the sword up in front of the body, the left hand stays free as a guard, the left foot steps forward and the knees bend

actions.move: Seamless combat run in place carrying the sword, no attack. The last frame leads into the first, no pause
actions.b2: Thrust, then rising cut. Frames 1-5 draw back; frame 6 a straight thrust; frames 7-8 the sword drops low; frame 9 a rising cut; frames 10-11 the sword finishes high. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The great curved saber stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.a3: One straight thrust. Frames 1-5 the sword is drawn back beside the hip; frames 6-8 a step forward and a straight thrust, point first; frames 9-11 hold the reach. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The great curved saber stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.b3: Leaping downward cut. Frames 1-4 crouch and raise the sword; frames 5-7 both feet leave the ground; frame 8 he lands cutting straight down; frames 9-11 absorb the landing. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The great curved saber stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.s1: Hidden low, then a rising cut. Frames 1-6 he folds the knees deep and hides the sword low behind the body; frame 8 the legs drive up and the sword cuts from below upward; frames 9-12 the body rises with it. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The great curved saber stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.

notes: 2026-11-19 make_configs.py. 평타 b2 → a3 → b3, 전법 s1. 무기 좌표는 원화에서 눈으로 잰 값(±2px), 가려진 끝은 추정.
